title: Probing Where Surprise Happens: Localized Violation-of-Expectation Evaluation of Video World Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.18979v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Violation-of-expectation (VOE) benchmarks evaluate intuitive physics in video world models by testing whether physically impossible events produce greater prediction errors than matched possible events. However, conventional VOE evaluations aggregate prediction errors across space and time, making it unclear whether successful discrimination reflects model's understanding of physical violations at the locations and time where they occur. To address this limitation, we introduce localized VOE evaluation, a framework that measures prediction error differences between possible and impossible events within spatial regions and temporal intervals associated with physical violations. We compare global, temporally localized, and spatiotemporally localized evaluations of V-JEPA models pretrained on developmental egocentric videos or large-scale natural video datasets. translated_title: 探测“惊讶”发生之处：视频世界模型的局部化违反期望评估
translated_abstract: 违反期望（Violation-of-Expectation，VOE）基准通过测试物理上不可能的事件是否比匹配的物理可能事件产生更大的预测误差，来评估视频世界模型的直觉物理能力。然而，传统的VOE评估将预测误差在空间和时间上进行整体聚合，这使得成功的判别结果是否真正反映了模型在物理违背发生的具体位置和时间上的理解变得不明确。为了解决这一局限性，我们提出了局部化VOE评估，这是一个在与物理违背相关的空间区域和时间区间内测量物理可能事件与不可能事件之间预测误差差异的框架。我们比较了在发展性自我中心视频或大规模自然视频数据集上预训练的V-JEPA模型的全局评估、时间局部化评估以及时空局部化评估。我们的结果揭示，全局判断与局部化判断可能在两个方向上都出现分歧。
tldr: 该论文提出了局部化违反期望（VOE）评估框架，通过在与物理违背相关的具体空间区域和时间区间内测量预测误差差异，克服了传统全局聚合评估无法判断模型是否真正理解物理违背发生位置和时间的缺陷，并发现全局与局部评估结果可能存在分歧。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a localized violation-of-expectation (VOE) evaluation framework that measures prediction error differences within the spatial regions and temporal intervals where physical violations occur, revealing that global and localized judgments of video world models' intuitive physics understanding can diverge.
